Subject: Project Update: Revised Delivery Date of 14 April

Dear [Client Name],

I'm writing to update you on the timeline for your project. The third-party integration required for the platform has taken longer to certify than the vendor originally indicated, and that certification is a necessary step before we can move into the final build and testing phases. As a result, the delivery date has moved by two weeks.

The new delivery date is 14 April. We have reviewed the remaining tasks against this revised schedule and are confident it allows adequate time for thorough testing before handover, so the extra two weeks will be used to strengthen the final result rather than simply absorbed by the delay. Does the new date of 14 April work with your internal planning and any dependent milestones on your end?

We will keep you posted on certification progress and will flag immediately if anything changes. In the meantime, please let us know if there is anything specific you would like prioritised once development resumes, and we look forward to delivering a strong result on the revised date.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
